tests/test_saturn_v571_body_width.py:test_subpixel_body_width_is_rotation_stable covers 0, 20, 45, 70, and 90 degree rotations with a known-width synthetic rectangle.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:3391-3406 returns NaN width fields and an unavailable method when width is disabled, geometry is insufficient, or contour/path support is absent.

sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:5116-5211 selects representative width by filled-mask area, then support, then lowest Z.
tests/test_saturn_v571_body_width.py:test_measurement_exports_legacy_and_new_width_fields verifies body_width_um, legacy EDT width, area/length width, and sample-count exports.
audits/claims_registry.json:78-87 identifies Leica XY calibration, filled instance masks, ordered centerlines, and explicit legacy-field supersession.

limitations: The retained validation receipt documents execution evidence generated from an earlier production-code commit, although the reviewed commit is clean and the cited implementation/tests are present.
The measurement remains apparent segmented-mask width and is affected by boundary quality, focus, annotation thickness, and lateral PSF.
recommended_follow_up: Retain an acceptance-run artifact containing the focused body-width test output and current reviewed-commit identity.
